title: ElevenAgents product overview
note: The official overview positions voice and chat agents around customer experience, growth, and efficiency, with configuration, deployment, monitoring, and integrations.
when: Use after discovery to frame a relevant capability hypothesis. Do not repeat marketing outcomes as Northstar commitments.

title: ElevenAgents for Support
note: The support page describes SOP-grounded agents, frontline deflection, faster response, human handoffs, guardrails, and analytics.
when: Use when Maya asks how routine service could change while preserving human escalation and operational control.

title: What is an AI voice agent?
note: This guide distinguishes voice agents from IVR and chatbots, separates suitable AI and human work, and emphasizes use-case selection, success criteria, testing, and deployment discipline.
when: Use to narrow the first use case and avoid presenting voice AI as a replacement for all support work.

title: Revolut customer story
note: ElevenLabs reports that Revolut reduced time to resolution by more than 8 times in the first rollout phase and expanded multilingual voice support. These are Revolut's reported results only.
when: Use only as a sourced proof example, with the exact attribution and no projection onto Northstar's baseline or expected results.

title: Deutsche Telekom partnership story
note: The English official story describes network-integrated calling features and contact-center voice work. It also describes joint technical work with ElevenLabs Forward Deployed Engineers.
when: Use for telecom context and partner collaboration, not as evidence of Northstar architecture, feasibility, or outcomes.

title: ElevenAgents documentation overview
note: The documentation maps agent architecture, knowledge and RAG, tools, workflows, SDKs, SIP, testing, analytics, and privacy controls.
when: Use to build a technical discovery checklist and identify which architecture questions need documentation or specialist validation.

title: System tools
note: System tools cover call state and routing actions, including agent transfer and transfer to a configured human number under defined conditions.
when: Use to discuss handoff patterns. Do not imply Northstar has configured a transfer destination or routing workflow.

title: Agent testing
note: The official testing framework covers next-reply, tool-call, and multi-turn simulation testing, including expected behavior and success conditions.
when: Use to propose validation evidence for responses, tool behavior, handoffs, and complete workflows before deployment.

title: Voice-agent evaluation framework
note: The six-pillar framework covers voice quality, conversation quality, task completion, intelligence, safety, and reliability. Its benchmarks are source-specific discussion material.
when: Use to broaden validation beyond a happy-path demo. Never import the article's numbers as Northstar targets.

title: Real-time monitoring
note: The enterprise monitoring guide describes live transcript events and control commands over WebSocket, with permissions, configuration, and event-order limitations.
when: Use for operational-observability discovery. Do not imply this app uses monitoring or that the feature is available in every account.

title: Amazon Connect integration
note: The guide describes a limited-availability integration where Amazon Connect owns telephony and routing while ElevenAgents handles the conversation, with specific account and workspace prerequisites.
when: Use only if Northstar confirms Amazon Connect and the team validates availability. It is not an assumed Northstar integration.

title: Genesys integration
note: The guide describes Genesys Audio Connector over WebSocket, flow integration, dynamic variables, audio requirements, and unsupported client tools.
when: Use only if Northstar confirms Genesys. Validate the current configuration and requirements rather than promising compatibility.

title: AI trust and reliability
note: The official page discusses guardrails, validation, monitoring, and searchable conversation records. Security, residency, retention, and compliance fit still require current account and configuration review.
when: Use to frame security and operational questions, never to guarantee that a specific configuration meets Northstar obligations.
